  "pros": [
    "Much simpler and faster invoicing than previous software",
    "Easy to track expenses and categorize them for tax purposes",
    "Cloud-based access allows for managing finances anywhere"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Missed some advanced reporting features found in QuickBooks Desktop",
    "Job costing capabilities were not as granular as desired for construction projects",
    "Initial learning curve for migrating data from the old system"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This owner-operator likely found FreshBooks to be a significant improvement in ease of use for managing their small construction home business, especially for invoicing and basic expense tracking. While appreciating the streamlined, cloud-based approach, they may have noted a reduction in the depth of some reporting or specialized construction-related features compared to their previous QuickBooks Desktop experience. Overall, the software likely provided a more efficient and user-friendly solution for their core financial management needs."
